$note: Maps the synthetic personas onto real licensed accounts in the demo tenant. The tenant has no spare M365 E5 / Copilot licences, so new users cannot be created - a user without a licence has no mailbox (mail import fails) and cannot be grounded on by Work IQ / M365 Copilot. seed_work_iq.py --map-users renames these accounts to the persona names and snapshots the originals to user_mapping.restore.json; --restore-users puts them back.
$driver_note: The account you sign in as to ask Work IQ questions. Work IQ only grounds on content the signed-in user can access, so the driver is cc'd on every email at seed time. Raj chairs the Renewal Council, so he legitimately sits across branch concerns, advisor feedback, escalations and executive guidance - the four categories the demo question asks for.
